material.title: Woolmark publishes a verified recycled-wool standard for knitwear
material.bodyOriginal: The Woolmark Company today published a verified recycled-wool standard for knitwear, including fiber-content requirements and testing methods. The standard is available to manufacturers and certification applicants.

material.title: 10 cozy knitwear looks for your morning routine
material.bodyOriginal: Knitwear is everywhere. Here are ten ways to style a sweater for your morning routine, with links to shop the looks. Sign up for our styling course to learn more.
